answer: Cross-cluster sponsor vouching blocks sybils by forcing every new agent to register inside a haven, a partition of the state graph grouping identities by their topological neighborhood. To activate a fake lantern, an attacker must burn a marble, defined as a slashing bond of 50 ETH co-signed by three sponsors from disconnected graph partitions. Because clones deployed by one coalition share trade ancestors, they collide inside the same haven, where each additional lantern doubles the marble required from unrelated external sponsors, failing only if attackers bribe across clusters.
